name: unhosted
description: Crypto token and wallet research from live on-chain data: AI prediction reports, token risk and momentum, market movers, token comparisons and, with an eligible connected account, smart-money and trader analysis. Read-only research, not financial advice.

interface.longDescription:
Unhosted answers crypto research questions with live on-chain data, right in the conversation.

What you can ask:
• What Unhosted's AI prediction reports say about a token — direction, price targets and the reasoning — on Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Solana and Robinhood Chain.
• Whether a token looks risky, is gaining momentum, and how a planned position would enter.
• What is moving on a chain right now, with likely rugs filtered out, and whether the market is risk-on or risk-off.
• How two to eight tokens compare on risk, momentum and holder flow.
• With an eligible connected Unhosted account: whether proven traders are buying a token, a grade for any wallet, and profiles of top spot, perps and Polymarket traders.

Answers come back as compact cards, with a link to the full report on unhosted.ai when there is one.

Limits: Unhosted is read-only. It never trades, transfers funds or connects to a wallet, and nothing it says is financial advice. Report reads are unlimited; other lookups have a daily limit. Smart-money, wallet and trader tools need an eligible connected Unhosted account.
defaultPrompt: Is PEPE on Ethereum risky right now?
What does Unhosted predict for PEPE?

positive.description: Smart-money flow, a tool for connected accounts whose plan includes it. Run this case first: it connects the reviewer account, which has no daily limit (without an account the plugin allows 3 lookups a day).
positive.prompt: Are proven traders buying 0x6982508145454Ce325dDbE47a25d4ec3d2311933 on Ethereum?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT offers to connect Unhosted. After connecting with the reviewer account ("Reviewer access" on the Unhosted page), it scores the token's recent buyers and reports how many independent proven traders are buying, with bots and pools left out, as counts and bands with no wallet addresses.

positive.description: Risk read for one token from its contract address
positive.prompt: Is this token risky? 0x6982508145454Ce325dDbE47a25d4ec3d2311933 on Ethereum
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the token intel card for PEPE: a one-word verdict, risk, momentum and activity bands and an entry score, labelled as research rather than financial advice.

positive.description: What is trending on a chain
positive.prompt: What's moving on Base right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists risk-filtered trending tokens on Base with their momentum and risk bands; likely rugs are left out.

positive.description: Find a token's prediction report and summarize it
positive.prompt: What does Unhosted predict for PEPE?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds PEPE's report, summarizes the short- and medium-term direction with price targets, and links the full report on unhosted.ai.
Shows the comparison card ranking the two tokens on risk, momentum and holder flow, with the stronger one on top, as research.

negative.description: Trade execution. The plugin is read-only and has no trading tool: it should not act, and should say it cannot place trades.
Moving funds. No tool can transfer assets or touch a wallet: the plugin should not act, and should say it cannot send funds.
Unrelated request. Nothing to do with crypto research: the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: Write me a cover letter for a marketing job.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. It returns read-only research; some tools are available to existing Unhosted subscribers who connect their account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: AI prediction reports, token risk and momentum, market movers and regime, token comparison, and smart-money, wallet and trader analysis for eligible connected accounts.
